conditions.meaning: Reports whether the controller accepted the connection configuration. Compare the condition’s observed generation with the resource generation.
Reports whether the controller accepted the source credential reference, when the configuration requires one. A connection probe tests access to the source.
Reports whether one responding replica using the current generation, admission epoch and release verified within the last 30 minutes the workspace artifact challenge. Source discovery is independent.
Reports whether at least one runtime pod is ready. Read status.runtime.readyReplicas for the count.
Reports whether the workspace can start a new scan on this runtime. Existing work can continue during a drain.

example.introduction: The installation closes admission while two runtime pods remain ready. Existing scans can finish.
example.nextCheck: Check the workspace and release before starting another scan. Wait for `AcceptingNewScans=True` at the current generation.
example.title: When the runtime is draining

outcomes.guidance: The configuration passed validation. Check the runtime and admission conditions before starting a new scan.
The specification failed validation. Check the provider’s connection schema. Create a new connection to correct an immutable specification.
The credential reference is acceptable, or the configuration needs none. Run a connection probe if you need to verify remote access.
The controller rejected the source Secret reference. Check the name, including whether it is reserved for a Prokrust-managed Secret.
The runtime verified the exact control object version and created and read the scoped staging object.
Wait for the operator to probe this connection generation, runtime release and admission epoch.
Check the runtime service account, workload identity trust or mounted artifact credentials and reachability of the token endpoint.
Check DNS, TLS, artifact endpoint configuration, network policies and storage service availability.
Grant the runtime identity version-specific read access to this connection's control prefix.
Grant the runtime identity create-only access to its connection staging prefix using the configured encryption policy.
Grant the runtime identity version-specific read access to its connection staging prefix.
Check bucket object versioning, object integrity and the immutable workspace binding.
Check token and storage endpoint latency and network policy before retrying the bounded probe.
Install a connector runtime that supports the artifact access probe.
Check the operator's workspace store binding and permission to issue a versioned control challenge.
Check runtime replica health, TLS identity and connectivity from the operator.
Check the designated owner's access to remove the two scoped probe objects.
At least one runtime pod is ready. Check AcceptingNewScans to determine whether it can accept new work.
The controller counted zero ready runtime pods. Inspect the runtime Deployment and pod readiness in the workspace.
The workspace is ready, a runtime pod is ready, and admission is open for the requested provider major version.
Check workspace enrollment, runtime readiness, and whether the installation is draining, disabling, or replacing the runtime.
